# Habakkuk Chapter 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A) | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HAB_001_page_001.jpg

---

**1:2** How-long [ad-anah], YHWH, have-I-cried-for-help [shivva'ti] and-you-do-not hear [lo tishma]? I-cry-out [ez'aq] to-you, "Violence [chamas]!" and-you-do-not save [lo toshia].

**1:5** "Look [re'u] among-the-nations [ba-goyim] and-see [vehabitu]; and-be-astounded [vehitammehu]; be-astounded [temahu]; for a-deed [po'al] [is being] done [po'el] in-your-days [bi-yemeikhem] [which] you-would-not believe [lo ta'aminu] if [ki] it-were-told [yesupar] [to you]."
